candidates.label: A
candidates.notes:
All text and furigana match the image, including both 締(し)め切(き)り readings, 用件(ようけん) and every 場合(ばあい). No invented readings. Email box rendered as a single-column table with
lines, which is faithful to the layout.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Base text is complete and the table is reasonable, but many furigana are invented that are not in the image: 書(か), 下(した), 来週締(らいしゅうし), 読(よ), 時間(じかん), 10日(か), 13日(にち), 件名(けんめい), あて名(な), 名前(なまえ), 毎週会(まいしゅうあ), 先生(せんせい). 10日(か) is also a wrong reading.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Invented 下(した) and 書(か)き. Omitted furigana on the first 締め切り, on 用件(ようけん), and on 場合(ばあい) in item ⑦. Email box shown with horizontal rules rather than a table; bold on the unit number and page number is harmless.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Invented furigana: お願(ねが)い in the subject line, 社会学入門(しゃかいがくにゅうもん), 来週締(らいしゅう し), 時間(じかん), 書(か)く, 書(か)き. Missed the second 場合(ばあい) and the final 終(お); 終わりの挨拶(お あいさつ) is awkwardly merged. No table or box for the email; 【例】(れい) placement is off.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Invented 書(か)き, 件名(けんめい) and 毎週(まいしゅう). Missed the final 終(お) in 終わるとよい. Table used but each body line is split into its own row; fullwidth angle brackets around the address. Otherwise accurate.

rationale: A is essentially a perfect match for text and furigana, with a faithful table. E is close behind, with three invented readings and one omission but a table kept. C has fewer inventions than E but more omitted furigana and no table. D invents more readings, including a whole-phrase one, and loses the box structure. B is last because it systematically adds furigana the image does not have, one of them a wrong reading, despite complete base text.
